issue: AE BLISTER (2014-08-17 to 2014-08-24) has an end date but outcome NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED, and appears to duplicate a second BLISTER record with identical dates and severity but outcome RECOVERED/RESOLVED.
query_text: Two adverse event records of BLISTER are reported with identical start date (2014-08-17), end date (2014-08-24), severity (SEVERE) and relationship (PROBABLE). One record has outcome "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" despite having an end date of 2014-08-24; the other has outcome "RECOVERED/RESOLVED". If distinct, please confirm the outcome of the record marked not recovered and whether its end date should be removed; if a duplicate, please correct the record accordingly.
